title: Bio verification receipt
description: Extends frame-receipt-v1 — this declares only what perturbation biology adds on top. The field to read first is the pair `max_status` (frame-owned: the strongest status a pass at this tier could ever support, never VERIFIED here) and `supports_status` (what this receipt actually establishes, null unless the verdict is a pass). Conflating them is how a failed check gets read as a weak pass.

supports_status.description: What this receipt actually establishes. Null unless the verdict is a pass — a check that failed or did not run supports nothing, and saying so explicitly is cheaper than trusting a reader to infer it.

status_refinement.description: The pack-specific label, e.g. CHECKED_REPRODUCED. A refinement never outranks the frame status it refines.

empirical.description: Always true here. It is the flag that stops an empirical receipt being read alongside a formal one as though they were the same kind of evidence.

design.description: What the denominator gate found: the biological unit, how many there were, and the effective sample size across a grid of intra-cluster correlations. This is the part of the receipt a reader should look at first.

analysis.description: The recomputed numbers. Not the reported ones — this tier ignores those.
